evidence.evidence_text: This task is inherently complex, requiring evaluations that range from object presence and attribute correctness to relational consistency and visual fidelity.

In contrast, while open-source MLLMs demonstrate promising skills in vision and language understanding, they underperform in comprehensive image quality assessment.To address these challenges, we propose a task decomposition evaluation framework based on GPT-4o to automatically construct a specialized training dataset, breaking down the multifaceted evaluation process into simpler sub-tasks and thus reducing learning complexity.
